$comment: The ~10 free-tier hardening items (SPEC 12): the plan spine for tenants with no paid Entra. Order is the intended sequence. goalId links to the catalogue goal's step where one exists.

items.name: Enable security defaults
items.description: Microsoft's free baseline: MFA for admins, MFA registration for everyone, legacy authentication blocked. The starting point when there is no Conditional Access.

items.name: Create and validate break-glass accounts
items.description: Two cloud-only emergency accounts, excluded from every policy and signed in on a schedule, so a mistaken policy still leaves a way back in.

items.name: Inventory legacy authentication usage
items.description: Find every sign-in that still uses basic authentication (POP, IMAP, SMTP, ActiveSync) before it can be blocked.

items.name: Eliminate app passwords
items.description: App passwords bypass MFA; move the apps that use them to modern authentication and turn the feature off.

items.name: Reconcile per-user MFA states
items.description: Legacy per-user MFA fights with Conditional Access and security defaults; set every user to disabled there before policies take over.

items.name: Separate admin accounts from daily-driver accounts
items.description: Admin roles on a mailbox-holding account make every phishing email a tenant-wide risk; give admins a second, role-only account.

items.name: Reduce Global Administrator count
items.description: Two to four Global Administrators is Microsoft's guidance; everyone else gets the least role that does their job.

items.name: Review guest accounts and external state
items.description: Remove guests nobody sponsors and invitations never accepted; what remains is what guest policies protect.

items.name: Disable dormant and never-signed-in accounts
items.description: An account nobody uses is an account nobody notices being used; disable after 90 days of silence.

items.name: Move users from SMS/voice to Authenticator
items.description: Text and call codes are the weakest tier; the verification campaign moves people to Microsoft Authenticator or passkeys.
